result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content (category chips and restaurant cards) is cut off at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and the bottom pizza card is clipped by the navigation bar mid-content. These are mostly minor/cosmetic layout concerns.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear visual cue that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient mask or scroll indicator at the right edge to signal that more categories are available via horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') mid-image and mid-title at the right edge without a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or peek-and-scroll hint so users understand the carousel continues horizontally; ensure card titles are not awkwardly truncated.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with '-20%' badge) is clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar, cutting the card off mid-image with no spacing buffer.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view above the navigation.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons on the dark restaurant card images rely on a semi-transparent dark circle; contrast of the white heart outline may be marginal on lighter image areas.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the favorite button background maintains sufficient contrast against all underlying image content, or add a consistent solid backdrop.
